notes: A181316.A181316_conjecture: for every integer q >= 2 and n, expCoeff (bq q) n is an integer, bq q n = (q-1)((q^n-1)/(q-1))^(n-1). Gauss congruences b(mp^a) = b(mp^(a-1)) mod p^a by three cases (p | c(M); p | q-1; else c(N) = c(M) mod p^a), then the Dwork/Euler-product machinery copied from OEIS/A207969. Outside Lean: none (exp(...) read as its coefficient recurrence; data agreement by certificate/check.py).
